name: mirage
text: Good question. The engine takes the reset date from ParlayAPI's own account answer for that key (its credits-month period_end), not from my assumption. For your Pro key it reads Nov 1, 00:00 UTC, the same as your Starter keys, which matched ParlayAPI's behaviour when I checked your Starter key on Sep 30 (credits reset on the calendar month, and the billing date is a different date). I haven't confirmed that for a Pro key bought a few days ago, though. If your ParlayAPI dashboard shows a different renewal date for it, tell me and I'll set the pacing to that date. If it really renews later than Nov 1 the pacing is just stricter than it needs to be, never looser.
